title: Effect of connector dimensions and span length on fracture resistance of high-translucency 4Y-TZP: An in vitro and finite element study
html: High-translucency 4-mol% yttria-stabilized tetragonal zirconia polycrystal (4Y-TZP) has been increasingly used for implant-supported prostheses because of its superior esthetics, yet connector size recommendations have been derived from studies of stronger conventional 3-mol% Y-TZP. Whether these guidelines remain valid for materials with 30 to 40% lower flexural strength is unknown.
